chapters.title: Phase equilibria and the lever rule
Computed versus measured, reproducibility and versioning

topics.title: Evidence type determines permissible inference
topics.text: Measured specimen data, computed model output, metadata indexing and author commentary have different provenance. Store origin, methods and missing conditions before numerical comparison.

topics.title: Property conditions are part of the reported value
topics.text: Temperature, loading orientation, rate, processing and sample state qualify a material property. A context-free scalar does not define a trustworthy component specification.

topics.title: Repository visibility is not a reproduction license
topics.text: Linked third-party data may carry provider-specific rights. The node stores identifiers and bounded paraphrase rather than mirroring unrestricted amounts of externally authored records.

topics.title: Composition is not phase identification
topics.text: A stoichiometric formula specifies atom count ratios but need not identify a unique polymorph, microstructure or state. A phase claim requires structure-sensitive evidence.

topics.title: Processing changes material state
topics.text: Thermal, mechanical and chemical processing can alter phase distribution, grain size, texture and residual stress without changing nominal composition.

topics.title: Bonding categories are explanatory not sufficient predictors
topics.text: Bonding families help organize trends but do not specify elastic, thermal or electrical properties without structure, conditions and model.

topics.title: Cubic unit-cell density is conditional
topics.text: Theoretical rho=n*M/(NA*a^3) for a cubic cell and stated sites. Bulk density also depends on defects, pores and multiple species.

topics.title: Bragg spacing and 2theta
topics.text: The first-order relation 2*d*sin(theta)=lambda uses theta, half the full scan angle 2theta. Peak assignment and instrumental corrections are external.

topics.title: Reciprocal-lattice reflections
topics.text: Reflection indices and diffraction geometry determine observed peaks; reciprocal-space interpretation and systematic absences matter for indexing.

topics.title: Grain is not a unit cell
topics.text: The microstructural grain is a physical region of approximate crystal orientation; a lattice cell is a mathematical periodic repeat. Sampling methods determine observed grain statistics.

topics.title: Defect families have distinct consequences
topics.text: Vacancies, dislocations, inclusions, pores and microcracks can influence transport, strength or failure differently. More defects do not universally mean stronger or weaker material.

topics.title: Equilibrium diagrams do not ensure equilibrium specimens
topics.text: A phase diagram requires specified conditions and equilibrium assumptions. Thermal history and kinetics can keep actual phases away from equilibrium predictions.

topics.title: Binary two-phase lever rule
topics.text: Given two endpoints on one tie line and a composition between them, the beta fraction is (C0-Ca)/(Cb-Ca). Compositional bases must match.

topics.title: Out-of-range tie lines must be rejected
topics.text: Negative phase fractions indicate incompatible inputs or extrapolation, not a physical negative amount of material. Missing phases and nonequilibrium render the model inapplicable.

topics.title: Reference-consistent formation energy
topics.text: E_f=(E_phase-sum(n_i*mu_i))/sum(n_i) in per-atom electronic-energy units, provided all references and corrections share a compatible basis.

topics.title: Lower convex envelope of supplied phases
topics.text: A binary 0 K hull computes the lowest convex mixture of provided energies at composition x. Missing competing phases and corrected energy scales limit its use.

topics.title: 0 K DFT stability is not room-temperature Gibbs stability
topics.text: Computed electronic energies usually omit temperature-dependent entropy and kinetic effects. Do not report 0 K energy-above-hull as a room-temperature measured equilibrium result.

topics.title: Functional mixing requires correction consistency
topics.text: GGA, GGA+U and r2SCAN total energies cannot be blindly combined. The Materials Project documents compatibility and correction pipelines.

topics.title: Database release can alter computed properties
topics.text: Materials Project correction schemes and thermodynamic entries evolve. Preserve database version, calculation identifiers and correction model.

topics.title: Engineering stress and strain from tensile geometry
topics.text: Engineering sigma=F/A0 and epsilon=ΔL/L0. A single point does not establish modulus, yield, toughness or ultimate tensile strength.

topics.title: Test coupon need not represent full component
topics.text: A coupon taken from selected material may not capture local geometry, residual stress, processing gradient or in-service environment.

topics.title: Elastic stiffness and failure strength differ
topics.text: Elastic modulus is a slope within a model and strain regime; yield and ultimate strengths refer to different deformation or failure thresholds.

topics.title: Free thermal mismatch is not stress
topics.text: A scalar free-strain mismatch equals (alpha_a-alpha_b) ΔT if expansion coefficients are constant. Actual stress requires constraint and mechanics.

topics.title: Diffusivity, conductivity and heat capacity differ
topics.text: Thermal diffusivity requires conductivity, heat capacity and density under consistent conditions. None is interchangeable without the model and units.

topics.title: Transport can be anisotropic
topics.text: Anisotropic crystals and textured parts require directional or tensor property data. Do not collapse a direction into an invariant scalar without rationale.

topics.title: Idealized iso-strain stiffness model
topics.text: The arithmetic stiffness mixture vEa+(1-v)Eb assumes a common strain and idealized constituents, not a certified composite stiffness.

topics.title: Idealized iso-stress stiffness model
topics.text: The harmonic scalar mixture 1/(v/Ea+(1-v)/Eb) assumes common stress and idealized linear constituents.

topics.title: Mass fraction and volume fraction are different
topics.text: A mixture model using volume fractions cannot accept mass fractions without constituent density conversion.

topics.title: Fatigue results depend on load history
topics.text: Cycles, stress amplitude, stress ratio, environment, geometry, surface and censoring affect interpretation. A tensile coupon strength cannot establish fatigue life.

topics.title: Fracture conditions differ from monotonic tension
topics.text: Cracks, geometry, constraint and loading rate control fracture testing; ultimate strength is not a general fracture toughness surrogate.

topics.title: A failed part does not identify a unique cause
topics.text: Combine fracture observations with manufacturing, assembly and service evidence; use a causal design to distinguish alternative explanations.

topics.title: Computed entries need a reproducible pipeline
topics.text: Record functional, code release, structure, magnetic initialization, convergence, reference energies, and corrections.

topics.title: Measurements need sample and machine histories
topics.text: Record raw curve, sample processing, geometry, machine configuration, calibration, environment and data reduction code.

topics.title: Metadata equality precedes property subtraction
topics.text: Compare only quantities with compatible property, units, method, state, temperature and orientation; even then statistical inference requires joint uncertainty.

topics.title: Data availability is not quality certification
topics.text: A public repository entry is not necessarily critically reviewed; provider rights and provenance must be checked separately.

topics.title: Selection requires service constraints
topics.text: Define environment, loads, aging, safety class, test standards, failure modes, cost and target before using tabulated material values.

topics.title: Measurement and causal interfaces remain distinct
topics.text: Materials owns conditional physical claims, Measurement owns calibration and uncertainty, Causal owns intervention effects, Manufacturing will own equipment-specific diagnosis.

topics.title: Unknowns should travel with material claims
topics.text: When processing history, test basis or physical conditions are missing, context consumers must preserve uncertainty and abstain from certification.
